sections.html: There are some other, similar looking species, like Hemigrammus erythrozonus (Glowlight tetra) or the several species of Flag tetra (Hyphessobrycon heterorhabdus, H. amapaensis, H. agulha, H. eschwartzae). However, Hemigrammus rubrostriatus can be distinguished from all of them even in fright coloration by a shining spot on the basis of the tail, which is lacking in all other species mentioned above. Such a spot is known in Hemigrammus for example by the Head-and-Tail-Light tetras (Hemigrammus ocellifer and H. falsus).
